excavation_context.character_description: An adult male grad student working as a museum preparator, dark brown hair, tanned skin, Latino ethnicity. Wears a soccer sport jersey worn UNDER a white lab coat, blue jeans and grey sneakers.
excavation_context.stage: Scribing Heavy Concretions Away from a Fossilized Skull Dome

composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_preparator_4 is sitting at a clean lab workbench, carefully steering a pneumatic air-scribe tool across a stubborn, dense block of rusty orange-brown ironstone matrix. His meticulous work slowly reveals the thick, heavily spiked, and highly textured bone dome of a Pachycephalosaurus skull. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
